note: Warhammer attack (2026-10-10, the user). Wind-up: 'lakasan mo yung bwelo … simula sa likod … naka side view siya, pero yung ulo niya naka tingin sa kalaban', the hammer 'held low near the ground behind the legs': the body turns 70 deg to its right (right shoulder back, chest side-on) while the head turns 70 deg back to the enemy (key field 'look'), the hammer swings back past the right hip (f 4) to low behind the legs (f 8, held to f 10, its lowest point at the ground), over the top (f 12) and down. Strike: the shaft level and forward, the head's flat end face straight down on the ground (f 14, held to 20). Aims are directions the arm reaches (read from built clips). steadyArms on. The left hand comes off the handle by up to 10-14% of body height during the wind-up: with the body side-on the left arm cannot reach the handle behind the right hip. Swing (2026-10-10, the user: 'make more frames from swing to hit … dont make the hammer teleport'): 30 key frames, hit at 21 (the shared 0.70 hit timing kept); from the held wind-up (f 13) over the top (f 16) and the front (f 19) to the hit (f 21) the keys are 'pass' keys — one accelerating curve across them, fastest at the hit — and 'wristStep' 1.0 lets the wrists keep up. Head travel per pose in the swing 20-33% of body height (was a jump of 89 in one pose); face 1 deg from flat at the hit, lowest point on the ground.
